subject: Request: partner bridge voucher for CloudSynd Accelerator trial extension
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@cloudsynd.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>; procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: accelerator@cloudsynd.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short trial top-up for Acme (CloudSynd cohort)

Hi Irene —

Hope you’re well. Quick ask from our side: Acme Corp (pilot) hit a procurement delay and needs an extra 60k inference-tokens to keep the proof-of-value running through the end of June. Without the top-up they’ll have to pause and risk losing momentum with the internal stakeholders.

We’re proposing:
- 60,000 tokens promotional voucher applied to Acme’s trial environment
- Valid through 2026-06-30
- Usage policy: only for the PoV project (contact: procurement@acme-corp.com)

Attached: high-level SOW (v2) and current usage snapshot for May. Can Redwood approve the voucher and confirm routing (marketplace credit vs partner-funded voucher)? We’d like to avoid invoicing for this stage.

Thanks — appreciate any quick help.

— Alyssa Greene
Partnerships, CloudSynd Accelerator
accelerator@cloudsynd.com

Attachments: CloudSynd_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), usage_snapshot_May.csv (text/csv)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@cloudsynd.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial top-up for Acme (CloudSynd cohort)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and the docs.

We can support a short bridge voucher, but I need to confirm a couple of operational points before we commit:
- Preferred routing: marketplace promo credit vs Redwood-issued partner voucher (partner voucher is quicker operationally but needs an internal approval code).
- Exact token accounting: you asked for 60k tokens — can you confirm whether that’s total tokens or generation tokens only? (we bill per model-token mix).
- Risk & escrow: does CloudSynd have a co-funding agreement with Acme for any overage?

Looping in Ben and Vanessa to advise on approval path and any finance constraints. If we can get a yes on routing and token type by EOD today I’ll push the approval.

Best,
Irene
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding a partner request. TL;DR: CloudSynd asks for a 60k-token bridge voucher for Acme to extend the PoV to 6/30 (procurement delay). Acme is a mid-market pilot (HIGH chance to expand), deal id DEAL-4821-ACME.

Questions for ops/finance:
- Can we issue a partner voucher (no invoice) for 60k tokens to be applied to Acme?
- If yes, what internal approval code / GL string do we need so partner billing and usage attribution are accurate?
- If no, is marketplace promo credit an alternative (slower for partner to redeem)?

Notes: CloudSynd will accept a partner voucher and has agreed to a strict usage guardrail (PoV only). Attaching their SOW and usage snapshot.

Can someone confirm by EOD 5/20? Acme’s stakeholders are asking for confirmation this week.

Thanks —
Irene

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial top-up for Acme (CloudSynd cohort) — approval needed

Irene — we can approve a partner-issued voucher for 60k tokens as a one-time concession for this PoV. Conditions:
- Voucher expires 2026-06-30; no extensions without a formal renewal ask and AE sign-off.
- Usage must be restricted to the Acme PoV environment (we’ll require a tagging rule on the account).
- Finance needs an approval code for bookkeeping: PR-ACC-4821-PV. Please include this code in the voucher metadata.
- No cash reconciliation required; partner voucher will be logged as marketing contra.

Vanessa — can you handle the voucher creation & entitlement tagging? Also, please confirm if we should route as marketplace credit or Redwood partner voucher (my preference: Redwood partner voucher to speed delivery).

Ben
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
